clips.send: One brush, one ink stick, one sheet of paper — Chinese artists have worked with just these for over 2,000 years. In the Northern Song dynasty, 18-year-old Wang Ximeng painted a scroll almost 12 m (39 ft) long — longer than a US school bus! And calligraphers practise all eight basic strokes in one single character: 永 (yǒng, “forever”).
